title: GE Cync bulb won't pair to app
fullDescription: Cync bulbs require 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth ON during setup. Phone must be within 6ft of bulb.

title: GE Cync Smart Bridge offline
fullDescription: Cync Bridge uses 2.4GHz Wi-Fi + Bluetooth mesh to reach BT-only bulbs. Offline state breaks remote control of those bulbs.

title: GE Cync schedules don't trigger
fullDescription: Schedules require account-level cloud connection AND device assigned to room. Bulbs in 'unassigned' don't run schedules.

title: GE Cync Matter bulb still needs bridge
shortDescription: Matter labeled bulb won't pair direct.
fullDescription: Some Cync 'Matter' bulbs use Matter over Wi-Fi but still register through Cync cloud first. True Matter direct only on newer Reveal HD+ Matter line.

fixSteps.title: Verify true Matter SKU
fixSteps.instruction: Check packaging for Matter logo only.

title: GE Cync outdoor smart plug unresponsive
shortDescription: Outdoor plug doesn't respond to commands.
fullDescription: Outdoor plug overheats in direct sun ≥85°F and shuts down internally until cooled. Mount in shade.

title: GE Cync dynamic effects greyed out
shortDescription: Effects menu disabled for some bulbs.
fullDescription: Dynamic effects require Full Color Direct Connect (or HD+) bulbs. Tunable White and dimmable bulbs lack effect engine.

title: GE Cync wire-free switch lost binding
fullDescription: Wire-Free uses kinetic energy + Bluetooth advertisement. Lost binding when bulbs reset.

title: GE Cync Reveal HD+ color shifts to pink
fullDescription: Reveal HD+ uses violet phosphor; phosphor degrades faster than blue/green LEDs producing pink shift after 1-2 years.

code: APP WIFI SETUP AP MODE FAIL
displayCode: App Wifi Setup AP Mode Fail
title: GE Cync setup hotspot CyncSetup-XXXX won't appear
shortDescription: Phone never sees Cync setup hotspot.
fullDescription: App should auto-switch to bulb's setup hotspot. iOS users frequently must manually join CyncSetup-XXXX SSID.

title: GE Cync mesh saturated >50 devices
shortDescription: App becomes slow / commands fail with 50+ devices.
fullDescription: Single Cync account practical limit ~50 devices via one bridge. Larger installations need multiple bridges or split accounts.
